import json
h,w=7,22
g=[[9]*w for _ in range(h)]
# Opposing edge bars remain unchanged.
for c in range(17,22): g[0][c]=1
for c in range(5): g[6][c]=1
# Replicated stroke from the top bar across its interior.
for r in range(1,6):
    for c in range(17,22): g[r][c]=3
# Rays from the bottom bar to each marked cell; recolor each marker as 4.
marks=[(2,2),(3,0),(3,3),(4,1),(4,4)]
for mr,c in marks:
    for r in range(mr+1,6): g[r][c]=3
    g[mr][c]=4
assert len(g)==7 and all(len(row)==22 for row in g)
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
